explanation: Gitano (Spanish Roma) families did much to shape it. Its singing is cante, its guitar playing toque and its dance baile, and UNESCO added flamenco to its intangible heritage list in 2010.

claims.text: Flamenco originated in Andalusia, in southern Spain.
Flamenco did not originate in Catalonia, Galicia or the Basque Country.
Gitanos (Spanish Roma) played a central part in shaping flamenco.
In flamenco, singing is called cante, guitar playing toque and dance baile.
UNESCO inscribed flamenco on its Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2010.
